gaps.contract-dependency: The real capability reporter enforces exact active, inactive, absent, wrong-basename, unreadable-version, below-minimum, maximum-exclusive and future-version facts offline. Exact 1.35 native activation is exercised; the full native dependency matrix remains required.
gaps.deletion: This capsule declares no deletion grants. Adapter-specific unsupported-delete no-mutation evidence remains required.
gaps.failure-recovery: Native capture publication refusal/retry and real post-materializer late-SQL rollback/retry are covered. Process interruption, durable recovery and native crash qualification remain required.
gaps.concurrency-idempotence: Transaction-bound option locks and stale intended-value refusal are tested offline; exact native no-op reapply passes. Controlled native competing-operation qualification remains required.
gaps.lifecycle: Source activation and experimental agent activation are exercised; exact-artifact deactivation/reactivation, downgrade refusal, uninstall residue and reinstall remain required.
gaps.scope-platform: Single-site WordPress 7.1/PHP 8.3 is exercised. Full unavailable-API and unsupported-platform assertions remain required; the native editor also emits upstream deprecation/enqueue warnings documented in qualification.md.

not_applicable.identity-references: The exact plugin defines no entities, tables, or post/term/user reference attributes: only zoom, height, address, api_key and one API-key option. Owning post/widget identities belong to core; conformance still forces different post IDs.
not_applicable.derived-state: The exact 1.35 plugin registers editor assets and saves static iframe markup. It owns no generated cache/index/table/file or repair action. Credential rebinding is authored transport, covered separately.
